recent.text: Former Mammoth assistant coach Mario Duhamel is joining the QMJHL’s Halifax Mooseheads as their new head coach. Duhamel previously was the head coach of two QMJHL teams. During this season, Duhamel was primarily in Montreal, scouting for Utah during Canadiens games. #TusksUp
recent.author: Chase Beardsley
recent.quoted_text: Some early morning CHL/QMJHL breaking news: The Halifax Mooseheads have made a coaching change. I'm told Brad MacKenzie has been let go, and former Utah Mammoth asst coach Mario Duhamel has been hired as the team's new head coach.

recent.text: While the Mammoth’s odds were in their favor against the Jets on Monday, they were given a taste of their old fortune from Saturday in a game that kicks off a critical week. #TusksUp https://t.co/19x98mTzZ6
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: That was the type of game Utah needed to find a way to win. It’s time for the top scorers to start scoring again. #TusksUp #GoJetsGo
recent.author: Brogan Houston
recent.quoted_text: Utah’s artillery is (mostly) back. Now it needs to step up Story by @houston_brogan https://t.co/8K0jvdpZvL

recent.text: First period mistakes cost Utah Mammoth in loss to Winnipeg Jets. More here ⬇️ https://t.co/I5EpZbdwz5
recent.author: Cole Bagley

recent.text: POSTGAME "I think we defend(ed) really well... I liked our possession in the O-zone, but we need to execute and we need to create more movement." @utahmammoth André Tourigny on the team's performance https://t.co/aM6xjf6vJ6
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: POSTGAME "It's frustrating. Obviously, we got to find a way to dig in in big moments, in big games... Just got to learn, regroup, look yourself in the mirror, and move on." @utahmammoth Lawson Crouse on tonight's loss https://t.co/xIcxLa6YUS
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: Final: Jets: 4, Mammoth: 2. Powered by a Vilardi hat trick, the Jets steal the two points the Mammoth needed. Tough one to lose for Utah. They had a great final two periods, but it proves how early mistakes can cost you the game. #TusksUp
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: Barrett Hayton and Mario Ferraro go at it after the final buzzer. Everyone on the ice piles up, shoving each other. The rematch between these two should be fun. #TusksUp
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: Both teams really needed this one — both sit just outside the last wild card spot. Winnipeg holds on to take both available points, jumping ahead of Utah in the standings. Final score: 4-2 WPG #TusksUp #GoJetsGo
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: Vilardi puts the puck into the empty net for the hat trick. Winnipeg will win this one. 4-2 Jets. #TusksUp
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: Gabe Vilardi completes the hat trick with an empty-netter. 4-2 WPG #TusksUp #GoJetsGo
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: Cossa to the bench. Extra attacker on for Utah. 2:11 to go.
recent.author: Cole Bagley

recent.text: Zac Jones just got pummelled with an open-ice hit from Dylan Samberg. He popped right back up, doesn’t seem to be hurt. #TusksUp #GoJetsGo
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: Jack McBain gets up slowly after both taking a Mikhail Sergachev show to the knee and falling onto his tailbone. Both happened simultaneously, and neither one feels good. #TusksUp
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: Jack McBain is hit by a Mikhail Sergachev shot and is slow to get to the bench. He's on the bench right now so that's somewhat good news. #TusksUp
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: Jack McBain slow to get up after taking a shot off his right knee. Made his way to the bench.

recent.text: Utah still trails Winnipeg 3-2 after the middle frame. Goalies finally settled in. Cossa with a few big saves & Utah’s defense was a lot better. Plenty of SOG for the Mammoth but need to find a way to tie things up in the third.
recent.author: Cole Bagley

recent.text: Huge save during the power play on the weak side by Cossa. Nice response by 33.
recent.author: Cole Bagley

recent.text: Explosive period offensively as the teams combined for 5 goals on 19 shots. Transition defense hasn’t been good for the Mammoth. Need to find a way to help Cossa out through the next 40 minutes. Still a very winnable game.
recent.author: Cole Bagley
recent.quoted_text: Utah trails Winnipeg 3-2 through the first frame. Defense & goaltending struggling to keep the pace at both ends of the ice. https://t.co/tkZ1pAT04R
